command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP 1: backup existing chrony.conf"
sudo -n cp /etc/chrony.conf /etc/chrony.conf.bak.$(date +%s)

echo "STEP 2: write new chrony.conf configuring node1 as internal time source"
sudo -n tee /etc/chrony.conf > /dev/null <<'EOF'
# node1: internal time source for the cluster.
# Fall back to public pool if reachable, but always usable as a local stratum source.
server 0.rhel.pool.ntp.org iburst
server 1.rhel.pool.ntp.org iburst

driftfile /var/lib/chrony/drift
makestep 1.0 3
rtcsync

# Serve time to the rest of the cluster.
allow 10.100.64.0/24

# Act as an authoritative local time source when no upstream server is reachable.
local stratum 10

logdir /var/log/chrony
EOF

echo "STEP 3: open firewall for NTP"
sudo -n firewall-cmd --add-service=ntp --permanent
sudo -n firewall-cmd --reload

echo "STEP 4: restart chronyd"
sudo -n systemctl restart chronyd
sleep 2
sudo -n systemctl is-active chronyd

echo "STEP 5: verify config loaded"
sudo -n chronyc -n sources
sudo -n chronyc -n tracking
echo "VERIFY allow rule:"
sudo -n firewall-cmd --list-services
